events.title: Grand Nordic 2027 Free Friday Kids Nordic Ski Lessons (Gear and Trail Pass Included)
events.time: Fridays, 1:00–2:30 PM MST; arrive 30–45 minutes early
events.location: YMCA of the Rockies Snow Mountain Ranch Nordic Center, Granby, Colorado, USA
events.cost: FREE for children ages 5–10: instruction, ski equipment and trail pass included. Three children: $0. Parent volunteers/helping receive free equipment and trail pass; two adults' charges if not helping and travel are unknown.
events.age: Children 5–10; beginner to experienced; 25–30 total spots per Friday. Public registration, no stated residency requirement. Parents may assist.
events.description: Limited-capacity subsidized hands-on cross-country skiing with real professional instruction and included trail access/equipment. Classic, skate and first-timer groups, games, final Nordic festival. Fridays Jan 8–Feb 26, 2027 only; advance online signup required, signup page exists but live inventory not confirmed. 2026/27 local Colorado residents' opportunity, before visiting family's June 2027 arrival. Official organizer page documents dates and eligibility; clarify parent entry if not volunteering.

events.title: 2026–27 Howelsen Hill Ski Free Sundays — Free Alpine Lift and Nordic Access
events.time: Sundays only, normally 10:00 AM–4:00 PM MST for alpine skiing; weather/terrain permitting
events.location: Howelsen Hill Ski Area, 845 Howelsen Parkway, Steamboat Springs, Colorado, USA
events.cost: FREE Sunday lift/Nordic tickets: $0 for 5 people (2 adults + 3 kids), compared with normal $230 total ($55 adult x2 + $40 youth x3). Equipment rentals, transport and meals extra; rental totals unknown.
events.age: All ages and general public; official city program lists no residency restriction. Free tickets must be collected at ticket office; no advance reservation.
events.description: Exceptional city-funded access to historic ski area: all five can use lifts or Nordic trails for free every Sunday during 2026/27 operating season, subject to snow and competitions. First expected Sunday Nov 29 after planned Nov 28 opening; do not interpret date range as daily availability. Tubing not free. Estimated $230 normal lift-ticket saving for five, subject to official rates and open terrain. Distant Steamboat Springs; 2026/27 local contacts only, before family's June 2027 arrival. Official city details: https://www.steamboatsprings.net/298/Lift-Tickets and https://steamboatsprings.net/131/Howelsen-Hill-Ski-Area

events.title: Jingle Bells & Pines — Original Schoolchildren's Songs with Ars Nova Singers (Free One-Day Concert)
events.location: Boulder Museum of Contemporary Art (BMoCA), 1750 13th Street, Boulder, Colorado, USA
events.cost: FREE for all ages; five-person family $0; complimentary tickets by reservation, walk-ins welcome if capacity.
events.age: All ages; public, not limited to performers' families. Approximately 150 seats, advance free ticket reservation advised.
events.description: Unusual one-off collaboration, not a routine orchestra concert: Bear Creek and Superior elementary pupils perform original songs they composed through EDEN Colorado school workshops alongside professional Ars Nova Singers. Free public premiere, limited ~150 seats; original student performance with no language-intensive talk. 2026 local contacts, before family's June 2027 arrival.
